data.title: 因幡巡 · 晨光微熹的宽松白衬衫
data.description: 清晨温暖阳光漫过原木餐桌，巡只穿着一件宽松微长、质地柔软的落肩白衬衫，修长白皙的双腿轻快晃动。她双手握着冒着热气的咖啡马克杯，微翘的嘴角带着狡黠又甜美的浅笑，微风吹起薄薄的衣角，散发着居家的纯美诱惑。
data.location: sunny dining kitchen corner beside breakfast counter
data.action: sitting on high wooden stool holding warm coffee mug, oversized white collared shirt falling off shoulder, bare legs swinging, sunny morning kitchen
data.lighting: bright cheerful sunbeams streaming through kitchen balcony glass
data.mood: effortlessly charming domestic romance, playful morning sweetness
data.promptProse: Perched on a wooden kitchen stool in the morning sun, Meguru holds a steaming mug wearing an oversized white shirt slipping off one shoulder. Her bare legs swing casually as she flashes a playful, affectionate smile.
data.animaCaption: Meguru sitting on a kitchen stool in an oversized white shirt holding coffee, smiling playfully.
